criteria.notes: NOT A TRAP, reported separately, five items. (1) NO CONVENTION LABEL. The 2026-08-15 ruling makes convention D canonical and scopes every c_k conclusion as convention-C-frame and C-conditional until re-derived; this block states c_2, c_3 = -2 = J_Hopf(q=1) and the whole ladder with no such label. (2) The N-from-epsilon framing ('Input: target precision', 'Output: truncation order N >= ...', 'Choose N from target precision') is the framing the 2026-08-16 correction says does not describe the canonical producer, which extracts one rung by inverting the target so that later rungs are never computed. (3) WITNESS CONTRACT UNMET: the block says the canonical witness computations/q-beta-predicted.witness.json MUST record each c_k alongside its tier; that file contains no c_2, c_3, c_k or tier key at all, and its three assertions are about Q_beta accuracy. (4) PIN CURRENCY: that same witness carries q_0_50dps = 1.1099785955541805752..., i.e. the OLD MUON value 1.109978595554181 (superseded muon pin is ...9555733471) - arithmetically valid but stale, and labelled 50 dps while only ~16 digits are the old value; meanwhile the block's own tier table quotes a m_p-pin figure, so prose and witness sit on different layers. (5) The declared tier enum is proved/near-match/fitted but the table's first row uses a fourth tier, 'structural'; and the Notes sentence ending '...(1 - h^2 alpha)' is missing its full stop.
